GRAIN COMMENTARY

Morning Grain Comments

MORNING COMMENT 10/16/2026

Corn down 1, Beans down 5, and Wheat down 1 cent.

Both soybean and wheat futures have dropped to new lows for the week overnight, as bearish sentiment looks to continue to hold across the space into the weekend.

Not much for news on the war side, Trump said Ukranes President is harder to deal with Than Russias after they bombed another power plant. There is also talk of Trump using the so called mother of all bombs on Iran since he doesent want to put any boots on the ground.

Dean Arends
